affected_locations: Dakshin Bedkashi Union, Koyra Upazila, Khulna District, Bangladesh
key_impacts: At least 33 people killed in Dakshin Bedkashi Union
3,520 houses washed away and 1,800 houses partially damaged in Dakshin Bedkashi Union
Coastal embankment overtopped and breached in six places; 20.55 km of embankment damaged in Dakshin Bedkashi
Villages inundated twice daily until coastal polders were rehabilitated in 2013, delaying recovery
Nationwide, 243,191 houses washed away and 370,587 houses partially damaged
evidence_snippets: Cyclone Aila hit the Bangladesh coast on 25 May 2009 with 65 knots and a 2–6 m storm surge.
In Dakshin Bedkashi, Aila killed 33 people, washed away 3,520 houses, and partially damaged 1,800 houses.
The storm surge overtopped and breached embankments in six places, damaging 20.55 km.
missing_information: Prolonged inundation period not precisely dated beyond landfall
Some impacts reported at national scale without subnational breakdown
